body_en: People discover places; scientists discover rules. You can discover too in daily life. Notice how plants grow to the light. Notice how ice turns to water faster in hot water. Keep a discovery notebook with date, method, and result. Asking questions is a skill you can practice.
body_zh: 人们发现地方；科学家发现规律。你也能在日常生活中发现。注意植物如何朝光生长。注意冰在热水中如何更快变成水。用日期、方法和结果做发现笔记。提问是可以练习的技能。
